scz.source: Trubetskoy 2022: clumping + thresholding at p<0.05 explained a median 7.3% of liability variance in left-out cohorts. This tool's own hold-outs (trained on one sex, tested on the other, about half the sample): 6.7% and 5.3%.

bip.source: O'Connell 2025: 8.4% with PRS-CS-auto in clinical cohorts, from the European GWAS without self-reported cases; times 0.8 for a clumping score.

mdd.source: Adams 2025: 3.9% for clumping + thresholding at p<=0.05 from this same public file (mean of 42 left-out cohorts). This tool's own hold-out on UK Biobank alone: 2.2%.

anx.source: Strom 2026: 2.27% with MegaPRS in UK Biobank; times 0.8 for a clumping score.

adhd.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 98,832) and SNP heritability (0.14 at prevalence 0.05) with M = 92,000. Demontis 2023 gives no hold-out figure on the liability scale.

asd.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 43,769) and SNP heritability (0.118 at prevalence 0.0122) with M = 92,000. Grove 2019 reports 2.45% on the Nagelkerke scale, which corresponds to roughly 1% of liability.

ptsd.source: Nievergelt 2019: 0.15% between independent PTSD data sets (clumping score).

ocd.source: This tool's own hold-out: trained without UK Biobank, tested on UK Biobank (776 cases): 0.7% with all SNPs, 1.0% with array SNPs. No published figure.

ts.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 12,611) and SNP heritability (0.21 at prevalence 0.008) with M = 92,000. Yu 2019 gives no hold-out figure.

an.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 9,794) and SNP heritability (0.2 at prevalence 0.01) with M = 92,000. Duncan 2017 gives no hold-out figure; the far larger 2019 GWAS (not on the Hub) reached 1.7%.

bpd.source: Streit 2026: 3.1% and 2.6% with PRS-CS in two independent replication cohorts (4.6% in the discovery cohorts); mean times 0.8 for a clumping score.

alc.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 16,634) and SNP heritability (0.09 at prevalence 0.159) with M = 92,000. Walters 2018 gives no liability-scale hold-out figure.

cud.source: Expected from GWAS size (Neff 65,408) and SNP heritability (0.121 at prevalence 0.085) with M = 92,000. Johnson 2020 gives no hold-out figure for the disorder itself.
